findings.note: Recovery treats an all-POST journal as a completed transaction and deletes it, although the same state exists after the final rename but before post-publication verification. A crash in that window therefore bypasses the required final race-closing verification and can preserve stale artifacts.

On a caught publication failure, rollback is invoked with discard enabled, removing the journal and batch before the caller writes artifact-publication-failed Block evidence. A crash between those operations leaves neither durable recovery state nor the required failure evidence.
